# Bank Indonesia in the dated reports

<!-- BEGIN GENERATED -->
## Identity and scope

The September 25 detailed reports attribute the September 23 BI policy hold at 5.75% to currency stabilization, then discuss company-specific financing, cost and risk-appetite channels.[^bksl-c2ef0f5604a2a67a][^bnbr-a50512c7bd8186ed][^bull-270816fba3cce331][^bull-b65b7de46fe80d87][^epac-8a9e4ccf50586c57][^gpso-d737030d107af0ac][^hmsp-6718bdc124e03030][^hrta-30a4845bd9a6638a][^icbp-c79c85e00a548f9d][^mina-b3a41fc7cf56b70d]

## Source perspectives

- **BKSL, 10dd, September 25, 2026:** The report attributes a September 23 BI hold at 5.75% to currency stabilization, while restrictive rates constrain mortgages/developer funding.[^bksl-c2ef0f5604a2a67a]
- **BNBR, 10dd, September 25, 2026:** The report attributes a September 23 BI hold at 5.75% to currency stabilization, with financing-rate sensitivity linked to CCT floating-rate expense.[^bnbr-a50512c7bd8186ed]
- **BULL, 10dd, September 25, 2026:** The report attributes a September 23 BI hold at 5.75% to currency stabilization, while emphasizing mixed USD revenue/cost and domestic-liquidity effects.[^bull-270816fba3cce331]
- **BULL, 5dd, September 25, 2026:** The report attributes a September 23 BI hold at 5.75% to currency stabilization, while emphasizing mixed USD revenue/cost and domestic-liquidity effects.[^bull-b65b7de46fe80d87]
- **EPAC, 10dd, September 25, 2026:** The report attributes a September 23 BI hold at 5.75% to rupiah stabilization, with imported film/resin/machinery cost exposure conditional on hedging and pricing power.[^epac-8a9e4ccf50586c57]
- **GPSO, 5dd, September 25, 2026:** The report attributes a September 23 BI hold at 5.75% to rupiah stabilization, with financing/imported-equipment sensitivity unquantified.[^gpso-d737030d107af0ac]
- **HMSP, 10dd, September 25, 2026:** The report attributes a September 23 BI hold at 5.75% to rupiah stabilization, with supportive local liquidity balanced against external-pressure concerns.[^hmsp-6718bdc124e03030]
- **HRTA, 5dd, September 25, 2026:** The report attributes a September 23 BI hold at 5.75% to rupiah stabilization, balancing currency stability against financing and inventory-funding pressure.[^hrta-30a4845bd9a6638a]
- **ICBP, 5dd, September 25, 2026:** The report attributes a September 23 BI hold at 5.75% to currency stabilization but treats rupiah pressure as adverse for imported inputs and financing.[^icbp-c79c85e00a548f9d]
- **MINA, 5dd, September 25, 2026:** The report attributes a September 23 BI hold at 5.75% to currency stabilization, with restrictive financing and risk appetite partly offset by reduced market stress.[^mina-b3a41fc7cf56b70d]

## Tensions and limitations

The reports retain mixed or unquantified company effects rather than a universal price forecast. Their shared policy references are repeated context, not independent verification of the remote announcements or current monetary conditions.[^bksl-c2ef0f5604a2a67a][^bnbr-a50512c7bd8186ed][^bull-270816fba3cce331][^bull-b65b7de46fe80d87][^epac-8a9e4ccf50586c57][^gpso-d737030d107af0ac][^hmsp-6718bdc124e03030][^hrta-30a4845bd9a6638a][^icbp-c79c85e00a548f9d][^mina-b3a41fc7cf56b70d]
